text:
Lia M: Heads-up — finalizing ops for Thu live roundtable (3pm PT). Need registration page, Zoom, recording, and post-event replay flow. Who can own registration copy + fields?
Samir P: I can do the reg page and GTM tags today. Questions: do we require company size and role fields?
Olivia K: Keep forms short. Only email, name, company, role (dropdown), and checkbox 'ok to contact'. Add hidden utm_source param.
Zoe-bot: Reminder: add HubSpot form mapping — field names must match HubSpot props: email, firstname, company, jobtitle, marketing_consent.
Samir P: Good — tagging: add `event:live-roundtable-mar2026` to contact and create static list `LR-Mar-2026-attendees`.
Lia M: Zoom setup — recording to cloud, transcript enabled, auto-delete after 90 days? our policy normally 30 but marketing wants 90 for replay window.
Olivia K: 60 days max for compliance; we'll go 60. Make sure captioning enabled, remove PII from transcript before publish.
Samir P: Zoom settings I'll set: Auto-recording=cloud; Record active speaker + gallery; Add alternative host @olivia; Pass registration required = yes; Wait room off.
Samir P: Config snippet:
```
zoom_settings:
  auto_recording: cloud
  cloud_recording: true
  transcript: enabled
  auto_delete_days: 60
  alternative_hosts: olivia@redwood.ai
  require_registration: true
```
Lia M: Post-event flow: Recording -> Vimeo (private) -> embed on site -> send replay email with gated page for name/company? We should gate for lead qualification. Thoughts?
Olivia K: Gate with email only, prefill from HS contact if exists. Email 1 (24h): replay link + highlights + CTA to benchmark whitepaper. Email subject ideas:
- "Thanks for joining — your replay & key takeaways"
- "Missed it? Watch the Redwood roundtable on inference ops"
Samir P: Also push a follow-up to registrants who didn't attend (nurture) with short clip + CTA to demo.
Lia M: Lead routing: Registrants -> HubSpot form -> assign owner to 'marketing-inbound' queue. Attendees who engage with replay -> score +10, create task for AE if score > 50.
Zoe-bot: FYI: Add segment.track event "Event Replayed" with properties {event_id, watched_percent, watch_time}. We'll use for scoring.
Olivia K: Assets: 3 clips (30s, 90s, 5min). Who cuts them?
Samir P: I'll brief the vendor (ClipLab) and upload raw to drive after recording.
Lia M: Final checklist before Thu EOD:
- reg page live + HS form mapping (Samir P)
- Zoom config + alternative host (Samir P)
- Recording retention 60d (Samir P)
- Post-event email copy + subject (Olivia K)
- Clips vendor brief + drive upload (Samir P)
- Segment + HS mapping + lead routing (Zoe-bot)
Olivia K: I'll draft email and share for review by tomorrow noon. :thumbsup:
Samir P: Done — pushed reg page draft: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/12345/roundtable-mar2026
Lia M: Perfect. Anyone object to gating replay? quick vote.
Olivia K: +1
Samir P: +1
Zoe-bot: Poll result: 3/3 yes.
Lia M: Great — closing thread. I'll post final ops doc in #marketing on Wed.
